title: 第一章 万族领主
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
【欢迎各位玩家来到万族领主时代！】

    【您已成为一名光荣的领主，每一位领主都可以觉醒天赋！】

    【生存，扩张，征服，这是您唯一的任务！】

    【新手保护期：三天！（期间不会出现怪物，也不会有任何野兽攻击您的领地，不过各位领主可互相攻击掠夺资源）】

    【祝各位玩家好运！】

    秦天听到耳边冰冷的提示音，看着眼前陌生的场景，总算接受了自己穿越了这个事实。

    眼前是一座由茅草搭建的简易房屋，外围是一圈木制栅栏，领地内还有十个身着粗布麻衣的男女，有些茫然的站在他的面前，目光逐渐清醒。

    当他们看清楚站在最中间的秦天之后，连忙跪在他身前，跪下叩首。

    “领民！参见领主大人！”

    这十人正是领地拥有的初始领民。

    秦天的面前也顿时弹出来了一个半透明的面板。

    【领主：秦天】

    【领主等级：0级】

    【领地等级：1级】

    【升级所需：木材*100，石材*100，食物*100】

    【领地人口：10（当前人口上限10）】

    【建筑：普通茅草屋】

    【功能：世界频道（已开启）区域频道（已开启）交易品台（已开启）】

    界面简介，信息清晰。

    秦天注意到了角落还有一个【天赋】。

    他随即将其点开。

    【天赋：无限进化】

    【品质：SSS级（全大陆唯一级）】

    SSS级？

    秦天顿时心头一跳。

    居然是SSS级天赋？还是全大陆的唯一天赋！

    根据自己多年玩游戏的经验，这种开局绝对是天胡！

    【天赋介绍：领主可以通过领主经验对领地内的所有东西进行进化，已进化的物品不可再次进化】

    【提示：领主可以通过开扩领地，猎杀猎物，增加领民……获得经验值！】

    【提示：领主可以通过在世界频道交易，或者选择在交易品台自动回收获得领主币！】

    【初次进化：100领主币】

    【中级进化：1000领主币】
content_en:
[Welcome all players to the era of lords of all races! 】

    [You have become a glorious lord, and every lord can awaken talents! 】

    【Survive, expand, conquer, this is your only mission! 】

    [Novice protection period: three days! (No monsters will appear during this period, nor will any beasts attack your territory, but the lords can attack each other and plunder resources)]

    [Wish all players good luck! 】

    Qin Tian heard the cold sound in his ear, looked at the unfamiliar scene in front of him, and finally accepted the fact that he had traveled through time.

    In front of him was a simple house made of thatched grass, surrounded by a wooden fence. There were ten men and women in coarse linen clothes in the territory, standing in front of him in a daze, their eyes gradually clearing.

    When they clearly saw Qin Tian standing in the middle, they quickly knelt in front of him, knelt down and kowtowed.

    "Leaders! Meet the lord!"

    These ten people are the initial citizens of the territory.

    A translucent panel suddenly popped up in front of Qin Tian.

    [Lord: Qin Tian]

    [Lord Level: Level 0]

    [Territory Level: Level 1]

    [Required for upgrading: wood*100, stone*100, food*100]

    [Territory population: 10 (current population upper limit: 10)]

    [Building: Ordinary thatched house]

    [Function: World Channel (already open) Regional Channel (already open) Trading Product Desk (already open)]

    The interface is brief and the information is clear.

    Qin Tian noticed another [Talent] in the corner.

    He then clicked it open.

    [Talent: Infinite Evolution]

    [Quality: SSS grade (the only grade in the continent)]

    SSS level?

    Qin Tian's heart suddenly jumped.

    It's actually an SSS-level talent? Or the only talent in the entire continent!

    Based on my many years of experience in playing games, this kind of start is definitely a bad start!

    [Talent introduction: The lord can evolve everything in the territory through lord experience. Evolved items cannot evolve again]

    [Tip: Lords can gain experience points by expanding their territories, hunting prey, and increasing their territory's citizens...! 】

    [Tip: Lords can obtain lord coins by trading in the world channel, or choosing to automatically recycle them at the trading desk! 】

    [First evolution: 100 Lord Coins]

    [Intermediate evolution: 1000 lord coins]
